First steps: - The system starts when the ignition is switched on.
- Initial configuration may include language, time, and display preferences.
- Personal user profiles can be created and loaded at startup.
- Use touch screen or steering controls to navigate menus.
Overview and controls: - Touchscreen is the main interface for infotainment functions.
- Shortcuts, widgets, and home screen layout can be customized.
- Use swipe, tap, and long press gestures to interact with menus.
- Volume and quick functions are accessible via touch sliders or buttons.
General instructions for use: - Do not operate the system while driving unless absolutely necessary.
- Regular software updates may add new functions or improve stability.
- Settings can be restored to default if needed.
- Use voice commands or CUPRA Assistant for hands-free operation.
CUPRA Assistant: - Voice-controlled assistant responds to natural speech.
- Say “Hola, Hola” or press the voice control button to activate.
- Can control navigation, media, phone, and climate settings.
- Adapts to user preferences over time.
Radio mode: - Supports FM/DAB/Internet radio depending on region and configuration.
- Station lists can be updated manually or automatically.
- Favorites can be stored and reordered.
- RDS provides additional information like station name and song title.
Media Mode: - Play media from USB, Bluetooth, SD card, or streaming services.
- Media source selection is done through the main menu.
- Album art and metadata are displayed when available.
- Playback controls include repeat, shuffle, and browsing by folder or tag.
Navigation: - GPS-based system with 2D/3D map views and turn-by-turn directions.
- Online features offer real-time traffic, POI search, and route recalculation.
- Input destinations via address, voice, or recent destinations.
- Route options include fastest, shortest, and eco-friendly.
Telephone interface: - Pair phones via Bluetooth for calls and messaging.
- Access contacts, call history, and keypad through the touchscreen.
- Voice dialing and SMS readout available for supported devices.
- Call audio is routed through the vehicle’s speaker system.
